basis: Leg D trend rules on unrounded Yahoo adjusted closes, with the same sessions and gap/split checks as share/ticker-timing.json, at the last month-end close on or before the snapshot (signal_date): [A price above 200-day SMA, B 12-1 month return above zero, C 50-day SMA above 200-day]; 1 up, 0 down, null = too little history. momentum_12_1 is rule B's return.
